svg.text: ONE SESSION — ABOUT 2 MIN 20 S (SAME STRUCTURE FOR WOOD, FIRE, WATER)
guided breath: inhale · hold · exhale · energy
bamboo / lantern / rain / leaves / birds appear as the arrival line ends
ground ring and scene follow 4 s in · 2 s hold · 6 s out
Before 0 s: a card is chosen, the portal line plays and mist fills the view for 3 s.
